title: AUREN Official Country Company and Bank Sources — Batch 2
scope: Official country-level starting points for company registration, industrial/export company discovery, and regulated-bank checks in Sudan, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and China.
source_policy: These records are discovery references only; they are not live API integrations.
A company registry or export-control register does not by itself prove that a business currently operates a factory or has available stock.
A bank regulator listing does not prove solvency, cross-border transfer availability, or that a service can onboard AUREN users.
All URLs and exact register paths remain subject to manual validation before being marked verified or integrated.

records.name: Central Bank of Sudan — Operating Banks
records.purpose: Starting point for identifying banks reported as operating in Sudan; confirm current status and licensing directly with the Central Bank.

records.name: Egypt ITDA — Unified Commercial Registry Inquiry
records.purpose: Check whether a commercial entity exists in the Unified Commercial Registry and whether its record is active or canceled.

records.name: Egypt GOEIC — Company Register
records.purpose: Company registration and trade-related records, including industrial/importer/exporter-related documentation where applicable.

records.name: Egypt Business Sector Information Center
records.purpose: Starting point for public business-sector and state-owned industrial company information; not a complete private factory directory.

records.name: UAE National Economic Register
records.purpose: Official portal describing how to look up economic licences, business activities, and registered companies across UAE licensing authorities.

records.name: Central Bank of the UAE — Licensing and Financial Institutions Register
records.purpose: Search financial institutions and review licence-related information, including banks.

records.name: Saudi Central Bank — Licensed Banks
records.purpose: Check local banks and foreign-bank branches listed by the Saudi Central Bank; confirm licence and operating status at lookup time.

records.name: China National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
records.purpose: Official starting point for Chinese enterprise registration and public credit information; accessibility and search behavior may vary.

records.name: National Financial Regulatory Administration of China
records.purpose: Official financial regulator portal and starting point for banking-sector supervision information; exact institution-list endpoint needs validation.
